notes: Example for a request log table: requests(ts DateTime, team String, status UInt16, latency_ms Float64, cost_usd Float64).

metrics.label: Requests
metrics.query: SELECT $bucket(ts) AS t, team, count() AS value FROM requests WHERE $range(ts) GROUP BY t, team

metrics.label: Failed requests
metrics.query: SELECT $bucket(ts) AS t, countIf(status >= 500) AS value FROM requests WHERE $range(ts) GROUP BY t

metrics.label: Median latency
metrics.query: SELECT $bucket(ts) AS t, quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS value FROM requests WHERE $range(ts) GROUP BY t
metrics.description: Median per hour; a longer range shows the mean of the hourly medians

metrics.label: Spend
metrics.query: SELECT $bucket(ts) AS t, team, sum(cost_usd) AS value FROM requests WHERE $range(ts) GROUP BY t, team
metrics.description: Billed cost recorded with each request
